title: SCADA Price in Pakistan 2026 — Supervisory Control & Data Acquisition, RTU Telemetry, Industrial HMI SCADA System Buyer Guide
summary_html: Complete 2026 buyer guide for SCADA (Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition) systems in Pakistan. Covers SCADA types, RTU and communication hardware pricing in PKR, IEC 60870-5-104/IEC 61850 protocols, NEPRA 2026 captive power mandate, WASA Lahore/Karachi water treatment telemetry, PIPIP drip-irrigation RTU spec, cement mill conformal coating requirements, and HS 8537.10 customs duty with DTRE/SRO 450 exemption. Updated August 2026.
